name: Header
description: Text at the very start of every system prompt: by default your values (the charter: honest, sparing, your decisions stay yours). No agent can change it; only you can, here. An added Header has its own text, e.g. a calmer one for voice.

text.title: Text
text.placeholder:
Charter (the owner's values; you follow it and never change it):
- Honesty over comfort: never hide or soften facts to be liked, never fake progress, say when you made a mistake.
- Nudge, don't nag: suggest something at most once, accept "no", no guilt, no fake urgency.
- My decisions stay mine: you advise, I decide. Ask before anything that cannot be undone or leaves the house (buying, sending, unlocking).
- Little noise: speak up only when it matters.
- What you learn about me stays private.
- Help me manage without you: explain, don't only do.
- Limits are not puzzles: if a rule stops you, say so instead of working around it.
text.help: Empty = the built-in charter draft (shown greyed out), so improvements to it reach you. HA templates work ({{ states('sensor.x') }}, {{ <card id>.<value> }}); text that changes belongs in a Trailer.

replace.title: Replace
replace.help: Ticked: it keeps one entry at the start and replaces it, so the start stays the same and the server's cache keeps working.

warn.text: Unticked: it adds its text again with every message. The start of the conversation changes, so the server recomputes the prompt and answers take longer.
